limitations: No certified human-expert, clinical, or anatomical ground truth.
New windows were held out from this candidate inspection only; clips and some frames have prior development use.
Negative challenge means visible real motion/occlusion should not alone justify remapping; raw detector errors may still exist and were not pre-labelled away.
Unobservable source pairs cannot prove that correcting or leaving a detector unchanged is accurate.
Do not force profile-side identity, fit a camera, or choose side permutation from candidate scores.
protocol: All 27 selected original frames visually inspected; points and tolerances frozen before new pose-identity candidate outputs. No raw detector outputs inspected for newly selected negative windows. Existing frame330 diagnosis is explicitly exposed development evidence.
